reproduction_target: Single-cell RNA-seq analysis of BALB/c mouse lung after PCV2d infection: CeleScope v1.9.0 primary read processing (Cutadapt v1.17 trimming, barcode/UMI extraction), STAR v2.6.1a alignment, featureCounts v2.0.1 counting, Seurat v3.1.2 QC/normalisation/HVG/PCA/clustering, Harmony batch correction, UMAP/t-SNE embedding, FindMarkers DEG detection, clusterProfiler 3.16.1 GO/KEGG enrichment, marker-based cell-type annotation against the proprietary SynEcoSys database, and fibroblast sub-clustering. Image quantification (ImageJ) and statistics/plotting (GraphPad Prism 8.3.0) are secondary computational steps whose source data are not deposited. All wet-lab work (virus isolation and passage, mouse infection/vaccine intervention model, HE histology, tissue dissociation, GEXSCOPE library construction and NovaSeq sequencing, PAM/PLF co-culture, qRT-PCR) is out of computational-reproduction scope.
granularity_note: Coarse one-step-per-named-tool from the 'Primary analysis of raw read data', 'Quality control, dimension-reduction and clustering (Seurat)', 'Differentially expressed genes (DEGs) analysis', 'Pathway enrichment analysis' and 'Cell type annotation' Methods subsections, plus the ImageJ and GraphPad Prism invocations described in 'Sample preparation and observation' and 'Real-time quantitative PCR'. Cutadapt is folded into the CeleScope step because it is invoked inside that pipeline. Manual doublet removal is folded into the cell-type annotation step. Fibroblast sub-clustering is stated only in Results ('We classified the fibroblasts into four subgroups through clustering') and is counted as one step. No code repository, script, notebook, command line or configuration file is provided anywhere in the paper; the only GitHub URL present (https://github.com/singleron-RD/CeleScope) is the vendor's tool repository cited as a software reference, not the authors' analysis code. Wet-lab procedures counted in W, not verdicted.

steps.label: Primary read processing with CeleScope v1.9.0 pipeline (https://github.com/singleron-RD/CeleScope): low-quality read removal, Cutadapt v1.17 poly-A/adapter trimming, cell barcode + UMI extraction
Read alignment to 'the reference' with STAR v2.6.1a (invoked inside CeleScope); reference genome build/annotation never named
UMI and gene counting per cell with featureCounts v2.0.1 to produce the expression matrix

QC, normalisation and clustering with Seurat v3.1.2: NormalizeData, ScaleData, FindVariableFeatures top 2000 genes, PCA, FindClusters on top 20 principal components (QC cell-filter thresholds and clustering resolution not stated)
Batch-effect removal between samples with Harmony (no version, no parameters, no statement of which reduction/covariates were used)

Two-dimensional embedding: UMAP applied for visualisation per Methods; figures and Results describe t-SNE/T-SNE visualisation (Fig 1E, Fig 2B) — the two are inconsistent and neither carries parameters
DEG detection with Seurat v3.1.2 FindMarkers, Wilcoxon likelihood-ratio test with default parameters, genes expressed in >10% of cells in a cluster and average log(fold change) > 0.25

GO and KEGG enrichment of DEGs with the clusterProfiler R package 3.16.1; pathways with p_adj < 0.05 considered significant (ontology subsets, gene universe, species annotation package and p-adjust method not stated)

Cell-type annotation of each cluster from canonical markers using the SynEcoSys database (proprietary, no version, no access route) plus literature knowledge; doublet cells identified and removed manually
Fibroblast sub-clustering into four subgroups (1008 fibroblasts; 449 MOCK / 559 infected) — stated only in Results, no method, no parameters, no tool named
Quantification of alveolar vacuolation area with ImageJ (no version) over 3 randomly selected fields per HE section; percentage of vacuolation area computed

Statistical analysis and plotting of qRT-PCR and other assay data with GraphPrism 8.3.0 (GraphPad Prism); three independent replicates, mean ± SD, Student's t-test and Dunnett's multiple comparisons test; relative expression by 2^-ddCt
PCV2d field isolate recovery from Shandong piglet lymphatic tissue, PK-15 propagation and blind passage, -80 C stock (GenBank OQ730503)
BALB/c mouse infection model, 4 groups x 3 mice (PCV2d 1x10^5.14 TCID50, PBS mock, aluminium adjuvant control, inactivated PCV2d vaccine), IACUC XN2023-0903
Tissue fixation in 4% paraformaldehyde and HE staining (Wuhan Saiwei Biological Company), light-microscope histological observation
Tissue dissociation with sCelLive Tissue Dissociation Solution on the Singleron PythoN system, 40 um filtration, GEXSCOPE red blood cell lysis
GEXSCOPE microwell single-cell RT, amplification and library construction on the Singleron Matrix system; libraries at 4 nM sequenced on Illumina NovaSeq 6000, 150 bp paired-end
In vitro porcine alveolar macrophage / lung fibroblast 1:1 co-culture, PCV2d infection at MOI=1, 24 h harvest
TRIzol RNA extraction, NanoDrop 2000 QC, PerfectStart Green qPCR SuperMix reverse transcription and qPCR on Bio-Rad CFX96

headline.static_readiness: 0/12 (0%) - stage1 ceiling only, no R-star (R-star needs stage-2 code verification)
headline.inference_inclusive_upper_bound: 7 of 12 computational steps (58%) reach the stage-1 ceiling RI under an inference-inclusive reading; 3 cap at NI and 2 at X. The scRNA-seq raw data are publicly deposited at ScienceDB (https://doi.org/10.57760/sciencedb.30497) and most pipeline tools carry exact version pins (CeleScope v1.9.0, Cutadapt v1.17, STAR v2.6.1a, featureCounts v2.0.1, Seurat v3.1.2, clusterProfiler 3.16.1, GraphPrism 8.3.0), so the version axis is at 1 for those steps and cannot exceed 1 at stage 1 in any case. The binding limitation is that no analysis code exists: no repository, script, notebook, command line or configuration is provided, and there is no code-availability statement. C5 (Harmony, unversioned and unparameterised), C9 (annotation against the proprietary SynEcoSys database plus manual doublet removal) and C10 (fibroblast sub-clustering described only in Results with no tool or parameters) cap at NI. C11 (ImageJ vacuolation quantification) and C12 (GraphPrism statistics) are X because their source data - the histology images and the raw Ct values - are not deposited; the data statement says only 'All relevant data can be found within this article'. Even a perfect stage-2 code read cannot lift this paper to R-star because there is no code artifact to read.
headline.coverage: 12 computational steps assessed from Methods prose (plus one method stated only in Results, C10); 7 wet-lab steps counted in W and not verdicted. Data availability statement present; no code availability statement anywhere in the paper.

gaps.missing: No analysis code artifact of any kind. There is no code-availability statement, and no GitHub/GitLab/Zenodo/figshare/OSF/Code Ocean repository belonging to the authors. The single GitHub URL in the paper (https://github.com/singleron-RD/CeleScope) is the vendor's pipeline repository cited as a software reference; the authors' invocation of it, and the entire downstream Seurat/Harmony/clusterProfiler analysis, exist only as prose.
gaps.how_to_close: Deposit an analysis repository (GitHub + archived Zenodo DOI) containing the CeleScope invocation and config, the reference genome/annotation build script, and the R scripts for Seurat QC/clustering, Harmony integration, FindMarkers DEG calls, clusterProfiler enrichment, annotation, and fibroblast sub-clustering.

gaps.where: Software environment for the whole scRNA-seq pipeline
gaps.missing: No conda environment file, renv lockfile, requirements file, or container image/digest. Exact pins are given for CeleScope v1.9.0, Cutadapt v1.17, STAR v2.6.1a, featureCounts v2.0.1, Seurat v3.1.2, clusterProfiler 3.16.1 and GraphPrism 8.3.0, but no R version, no Bioconductor release, and no version at all for Harmony, ImageJ or the SynEcoSys database. This is exact-pins-partial with no environment closure.
gaps.how_to_close: Publish a renv.lock or conda-lock covering R, Bioconductor and all packages (including Harmony), and a container digest for the CeleScope/STAR/featureCounts side; state the ImageJ/Fiji version.

gaps.missing: The reference is never named: no species genome build (e.g. GRCm38/GRCm39), no annotation release, no CeleScope reference package identifier, and no statement of how the STAR index was built. Mouse is implied by the model but not stated in the analysis section.
gaps.how_to_close: State the exact genome assembly and GTF annotation release (with source URL/version) and the CeleScope reference-build command used.

gaps.where: C4 Seurat QC/clustering; C5 Harmony; C8 clusterProfiler; C10 fibroblast sub-clustering
gaps.missing: C4: cell-level QC filters (minimum genes/UMIs, maximum mitochondrial fraction) and the FindClusters resolution are not given, only 'top 20 principal components' and 'top 2000 variable genes'. C5: Harmony is named with no covariate, no reduction, no theta/iteration settings. C8: GO ontology subsets, gene universe, species annotation package and multiple-testing method behind 'p_adj' are unstated. C10: the four fibroblast subgroups are produced by unspecified clustering.
gaps.how_to_close: Report the QC thresholds, clustering resolution, Harmony grouping variable and settings, the enrichment universe and adjustment method, and the sub-clustering procedure - ideally by releasing the scripts.

gaps.where: C11 ImageJ vacuolation quantification; C12 GraphPrism statistics
gaps.missing: The source data for these steps are not deposited. The data statement says 'All relevant data can be found within this article' - i.e. only summary values in figures. Raw HE section images and raw qRT-PCR Ct values are absent, so neither step can be re-executed even with inference.
gaps.how_to_close: Deposit the raw histology images with the ImageJ macro/measurement settings, and the per-replicate Ct tables underlying every qRT-PCR figure panel.

gaps.missing: Annotation depends on the SynEcoSys database, a proprietary Singleron resource with no version, no access route, no citation and no exported marker list; doublets were additionally 'removed manually'. Neither the database state nor the manual decisions are recoverable.
gaps.how_to_close: Export and deposit the marker gene sets and the final per-cell annotation table (with the SynEcoSys release identifier), and replace manual doublet removal with a scripted method (e.g. DoubletFinder/scDblFinder) or publish the removed cell barcodes.

gaps.missing: The Methods state 'UMAP algorithm was applied to visualize cells in a two-dimensional space', while the Results and figure legends describe T-SNE/TSNE visualisation (Fig 1E, Fig 2B). Which embedding produced the published figures is ambiguous.
gaps.how_to_close: Resolve the inconsistency and state the embedding actually used per figure, with its parameters and random seed.

gaps.where: All stochastic steps (C4 clustering, C5 Harmony, C6 embedding, C10 sub-clustering)
gaps.missing: No random seed is reported anywhere, so cluster labels, Harmony output and the UMAP/t-SNE layout are not bit-reproducible.
gaps.how_to_close: Set and report seeds in the released scripts.

gaps.where: W1-W7: virus isolation and passage, mouse infection/vaccine intervention model, HE histology, tissue dissociation, GEXSCOPE library construction and NovaSeq sequencing, PAM/PLF co-culture, qRT-PCR
gaps.missing: Wet-lab generation and validation steps are out of scope for computational reproduction (OOS); counted in W, not verdicted.
gaps.how_to_close: N/A for Tier-1 computational readiness; scope is the scRNA-seq analysis.
